name: JTBD Switch Interviews
description: Bob Moesta & Chris Spiek's Switch interview with Klement's four forces: Switch interviews (fan) -> Map the forces (waist) -> Shape the hire (fan) -> Validate the switch (waist). Reconstruct the timeline of a real recent switch and the push, pull, anxiety and habit around it to name the job a customer hires for.
when_to_use: When you want the causal story behind a purchase or switch: why people fired the old way and hired a new one, so you can design something that wins the switch.

presentation.summary: Reconstruct a real switch and its four forces to name the job and design the winning hire.
presentation.jobs: Demand and switching questions: what job customers hire for, and what makes them change.

steps.name: Switch Interviews
steps.intent: Interview personas about a REAL recent switch — the moment they hired this kind of solution and fired the old one. Reconstruct the timeline of the struggling moment, first thought, passive and active looking, and the decision.

steps.name: Map the Forces
steps.intent: Map the four forces across the stories — the PUSH of the situation and PULL of the new way (which drive change) versus the ANXIETY of the new and HABIT of the present (which block it) — and name the core Job to be Done. Author payload.forces {push, pull, anxiety, habit} + payload.job_statement.

steps.name: Shape the Hire
steps.intent: Design solution levers that amplify push and pull while reducing anxiety and habit. Explore several distinct approaches and make the strongest one tangible as a prototype.

steps.name: Validate the Switch
steps.intent: Personas use the solution; test whether it actually wins the switch — enough push and pull to overcome anxiety and habit, would they fire the old way? Converge to a buildable spec.
